keyword: how many make the cut at masters
claims: The top 50 players and ties after 36 holes make the cut at the Masters Tournament.
The cut at the Masters Tournament occurs after Friday's second round.
Only the top 50 players and ties after 36 holes advance to the weekend rounds (Saturday and Sunday) at the Masters Tournament.
The previous rule allowing players within 10 shots of the lead to make the cut was eliminated as of 2020.
In 2025, the cut at the Masters Tournament was +2.
In 2025, 53 players advanced past the cut at the Masters Tournament.
If a large number of players are tied for 50th, the field for the weekend can exceed 50 at the Masters Tournament
